tools.name: list_vaults
tools.description: List the vaults this server serves. Every other tool takes one of these names as its required `vault` argument.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search vault notes. `hybrid` (default) fuses semantic + full-text ranks via Reciprocal Rank Fusion — no tuning needed, best for most queries. `semantic` is concept-only (better for abstract/paraphrased queries). `fulltext` is literal-token (better when you know the exact phrase exists). Semantic search is chunk-level — results are deduped to one-per-note by default. Set `unique: "chunks"` to return chunk-level hits with `chunkHeading`, `chunkStartLine`, and `chunkExcerpt`; supported by `semantic` and `hybrid` modes. `fulltext` is note-level only and ignores `unique` (full-text chunk search is not yet supported). Response is wrapped as `{data, context}` where `context.next_actions` suggests the agent's most useful follow-up call (read top hit, explore connections, or retry with broader phrasing on zero hits).

vault.description: The vault to work in. `list_vaults` describes each vault.

mode.description: Default `hybrid`. Semantic-only queries chunk vectors; fulltext-only queries FTS5.

unique.description: Default `"notes"` (one row per note). Set `"chunks"` for raw chunk rows with chunkHeading, chunkStartLine, chunkExcerpt.

tools.name: read_note
tools.description: Read a note's content. Brief mode (default) returns title + metadata + linked-note titles; full mode returns full content + edge context. Full mode also reports `truncated: true` when the body exceeded `maxContentLength` (default 2000 chars) and was sliced. Response is wrapped as `{data, context}` where `context.next_actions` suggests follow-ups like creating missing linked notes or exploring outgoing connections.

vault.description: The vault to work in. `list_vaults` describes each vault.

name.description: Path, filename, or fuzzy match for the note to read.

mode.description: Default `"brief"` (metadata + linked-note titles). `"full"` adds the body + edge context.

maxContentLength.description: In `full` mode, max body chars before truncation. Default 2000.

tools.name: list_notes
tools.description: List notes in the vault. Optionally filter by directory prefix or by tag (frontmatter or inline; `a` also matches `a/b`). Pass `sortBy: "mtime"` for the most recently modified notes first. Pass `includeStubs: false` to exclude unresolved wiki-link targets (nodes with `frontmatter._stub: true`) and see only real on-disk notes.

vault.description: The vault to work in. `list_vaults` describes each vault.

directory.description: Restrict to notes under this subdirectory prefix.

tag.description: Restrict to notes with this tag or a tag nested below it.

sortBy.description: Default `path`. `mtime` sorts newest first and adds `mtime` to each result.

includeStubs.description: Default `true`. Set `false` to exclude unresolved wiki-link targets.

tools.name: find_notes_by_name
tools.description: Find notes by a half-remembered name, like Obsidian's quick switcher: fuzzy, case-insensitive match against the filename, title and frontmatter `aliases`, best first. Use `grep_vault` or `search` to look inside note bodies instead.

vault.description: The vault to work in. `list_vaults` describes each vault.

query.description: Name fragment. Typos and non-contiguous characters still match.

folder.description: Only notes under this vault-relative folder.

tools.name: grep_vault
tools.description: Search the text of every note file on disk, frontmatter included, for a literal string or a JavaScript regex, line by line like grep. Returns matching lines with 1-based line numbers and surrounding lines; `truncated: true` means the scan stopped early at the file limit or the 2 s time cap.

vault.description: The vault to work in. `list_vaults` describes each vault.

query.description: Literal text, or a regex source without slashes when `regex` is true.

regex.description: Treat `query` as a JavaScript regex. Default false.

folder.description: Only notes under this vault-relative folder.

contextLines.description: Lines of context before and after each match. Default 1.

limit.description: Max files with matches to return. Default 20.

maxMatchesPerFile.description: Max matching lines per file. Default 5.

tools.name: query_notes
tools.description: Filter notes by metadata with a JsonLogic `filter`; the headless replacement for Dataview queries. Each note is `{path, folder, name, title, tags, frontmatter, mtime, size}`: `tags` merges frontmatter and inline tags without `#`, `mtime` is ISO 8601, and `{"var": "frontmatter.status"}` reads a property. The extra operator `has_tag` matches a tag case-insensitively, nested tags included. Example: `{"and": [{"has_tag": [{"var": "tags"}, "book"]}, {">=": [{"var": "frontmatter.rating"}, 4]}]}`.

vault.description: The vault to work in. `list_vaults` describes each vault.

filter.description: JsonLogic expression; a note matches when it is truthy. `{"==": [1, 1]}` matches every note.

fields.description: Frontmatter keys to return. Default all.

tools.name: find_connections
tools.description: Find notes linked to (from or to) a given note, up to N hops. Optionally return the full subgraph instead of a flat list. Response is wrapped as `{data, context}` where `context.next_actions` suggests follow-ups like tracing a path to the furthest neighbour via `find_path_between`. Broken-wikilink stub neighbours are excluded by default; pass `includeStubs: true` to include them.

vault.description: The vault to work in. `list_vaults` describes each vault.

depth.description: Number of hops to traverse. Default 1, max 3.

returnSubgraph.description: Return all edges in the neighborhood as a full subgraph instead of a flat list.

includeStubs.description: Default `false`. Set `true` to include broken-wikilink stub neighbours (`frontmatter._stub: true`).

tools.name: find_path_between
tools.description: Find link paths between two notes. Returns all simple paths up to maxDepth edges, optionally including their shared neighbors. Broken-wikilink stub nodes are excluded by default — they are degree-1 dead ends in the undirected graph and will block legitimate paths if left in. Pass `includeStubs: true` to include them.

vault.description: The vault to work in. `list_vaults` describes each vault.

maxDepth.description: Maximum path length in hops. Default 3.

includeCommon.description: Also return notes that both `from` and `to` link to (shared neighbors).

includeStubs.description: Default `false`. Set `true` to include broken-wikilink stub nodes (`frontmatter._stub: true`) in the path search.

tools.name: rank_notes
tools.description: Rank notes by importance: 'influence' (densely-connected hubs), 'bridging' (notes that connect otherwise-separate topic clusters), or both. Credibility guards (I): by default, `influence` excludes notes with fewer than `minIncomingLinks: 2` incoming edges — this filters out random-orphan noise that makes PageRank feel meaningless on personal vaults. Pass `minIncomingLinks: 0` to see the unfiltered ranking. Bridging scores are normalized by graph size (divided by n*(n-1)/2) so values compare across vaults of different sizes — a bridging score of 0.5 means the same thing in any vault. Broken-wikilink stub targets are excluded by default; pass `includeStubs: true` to include them.

vault.description: The vault to work in. `list_vaults` describes each vault.

metric.description: Ranking metric. Default `"both"`. `"influence"` = PageRank; `"bridging"` = betweenness centrality.

includeStubs.description: Default `false`. Set `true` to include unresolved wiki-link target stubs (`frontmatter._stub: true`) in the ranked set. With stubs in, popular link targets dominate eigenvector-style centrality even when they have no real content behind them.

minIncomingLinks.description: Minimum incoming links for influence ranking. Default 2. Pass 0 to see unfiltered PageRank.

tools.name: create_note
tools.description: Create a new note in the vault with a title, body, and optional YAML frontmatter. The new note is indexed immediately so semantic search and graph tools can find it. Auto-injects a `title:` field into frontmatter matching the note title unless frontmatter already has one.

vault.description: The vault to work in. `list_vaults` describes each vault.

title.description: Note title. Used as the filename base and auto-injected into frontmatter.

content.description: Markdown body (do not include frontmatter here).

directory.description: Vault-relative subdirectory to create the note in.

frontmatter.description: YAML frontmatter key/value map. `title` is auto-injected unless explicitly set.

tools.name: create_note_from_template
tools.description: Create a note from an Obsidian core Templates template, filling `{{title}}`, `{{date}}`, `{{time}}`, `{{date:FORMAT}}`, `{{time:FORMAT}}` and any `variables`. Templater `<% %>` code is not run and stays as written. Fails if the note exists.

vault.description: The vault to work in. `list_vaults` describes each vault.

template.description: Template name in the templates folder, or a vault-relative path. `.md` is optional.

title.description: Note title. Used as the filename base and for `{{title}}`.

directory.description: Vault-relative subdirectory to create the note in.

date.description: ISO date or date-time to use instead of now.

tools.name: edit_note
tools.description: Modify an existing note. Supports six edit modes: append (add to end; defensively inserts a leading newline if the source didn't end with one), prepend (insert after frontmatter if present, otherwise at file start), replace_window (find a block of text and replace it — optionally fuzzy; fuzzy extends match to consume trailing .?! so the replacement has no doubled punctuation), patch_heading (insert or replace content under a specific heading; `headingOp: 'before' | 'after'` inserts immediately before/after the heading line — use `before` on the NEXT heading to append to a section's end; `headingOp: 'replace'` with `scope: 'section'` (default) replaces to the next same-or-higher heading or EOF — CAREFUL on the LAST heading, this consumes everything below including content separated by blank lines — pass `scope: 'body'` to stop at the first blank line after the body; if the target heading text appears MORE THAN ONCE the call throws MultipleMatches listing each occurrence with its line number — pass `headingIndex: 0 | 1 | ...` (0-indexed, top-to-bottom) to pick one), patch_frontmatter (set a single YAML key; pass `value: null` to clear — or from XML-stringifying clients use `valueJson: 'null'` for true null, `valueJson: 'true'` for a real boolean, `valueJson: '42'` for a number, `valueJson: '["a"]'` for an array; `valueJson` wins over `value` when both are set), at_line (insert or replace at a 1-indexed line number that counts from file start including frontmatter lines). Pass `edits` (array) to apply multiple edits atomically — all succeed or none are written.

vault.description: The vault to work in. `list_vaults` describes each vault.

name.description: Path or fuzzy match of the note to edit.

mode.description: Edit mode. Required unless `edits` array is provided.

content.description: New content to insert or replace (meaning is mode-dependent).

search.description: For `replace_window`: the block of text to locate and replace.

fuzzy.description: For `replace_window`: tolerate whitespace and trailing-punctuation drift.

fuzzyThreshold.description: Similarity threshold for fuzzy replace_window matches (0-1, default 0.7). Higher = stricter. 0.9 is recommended for typo-tolerant matching of known-good text.

headingOp.description: For `patch_heading`. `replace` (default) replaces section; `before`/`after` inserts adjacent to the heading line.

scope.description: For `patch_heading replace`: `section` (default) consumes to next same-or-higher heading; `body` stops at first blank line.

headingIndex.description: For `patch_heading` when the heading appears more than once — 0-indexed top-to-bottom picker.

key.description: For `patch_frontmatter`: the YAML key to set.

value.description: For `patch_frontmatter`: value to set. Use `null` to clear a key. Prefer `valueJson` from clients that stringify params.

valueJson.description: For `patch_frontmatter`: JSON-encoded value (wins over `value`). Use `"null"` to clear, `"true"` for boolean, `"42"` for number.

line.description: For `at_line`: 1-indexed line number (counts from file start including frontmatter).

lineOp.description: For `at_line`: insert before/after the target line, or replace it. Default `replace`.

expectedContent.description: Optional guard for edits that replace text: the exact text being replaced, as last read. If the note changed since, the edit fails and nothing is written. Not with `edits`.

dryRun.description: If true, return a unified-diff preview without writing. Pass the returned previewId to apply_edit_preview to commit.

from_buffer.description: If true, retry a previously failed replace_window edit using the cached content + search with fuzzy: true, fuzzyThreshold: 0.5. Use when the prior edit failed with NoMatch. Cleared on success.

edits.description: Array of edits to apply atomically to a single file. If any edit fails, no edit is written. Applied in order against the accumulated state (each edit sees the result of previous edits in the batch). Use replace_window / patch_heading for content-anchored edits; at_line references the accumulated state, not the original file.

tools.name: apply_edit_preview
tools.description: Apply a previously previewed edit. Pass the `previewId` returned by `edit_note` with `dryRun: true`. Previews expire after 5 minutes. Fails with a descriptive error if the target file changed since the preview was generated — in that case, regenerate the preview and try again.

vault.description: The vault to work in. `list_vaults` describes each vault.

previewId.description: The previewId returned by `edit_note` with `dryRun: true`.

tools.name: link_notes
tools.description: Add a wiki-link from one note to another with a context sentence describing why they're connected. Appends the link to the source note and records the edge in the graph so analytics pick it up.

vault.description: The vault to work in. `list_vaults` describes each vault.

source.description: Source note to add the link from (path or fuzzy match).

target.description: Target note to link to (path, title, or new wiki-link ref).

context.description: One-sentence explanation of why these notes are connected.

dryRun.description: If true, return the line that would be appended without writing.

tools.name: move_note
tools.description: Rename or move a note. Inbound wiki-links in other notes are rewritten in place immediately (bare [[old]], [[old|alias]], ![[old]] embeds, and [[old#heading]]/[[old^block]] suffixes all handled). If the note's frontmatter has a `title:` field matching the old basename, it's auto-rewritten to the new basename (custom titles and missing titles are left alone). Response includes `linksRewritten: { files, occurrences }`.

vault.description: The vault to work in. `list_vaults` describes each vault.

source.description: Current path or fuzzy match of the note to move.

destination.description: New vault-relative path (including `.md`). `.md` is appended automatically if omitted.

dryRun.description: If true, report what would be rewritten without mutating any files.

tools.name: delete_note
tools.description: Permanently delete a note. Removes the file from disk AND its index rows (edges, embedding, node). Requires `confirm: true` to guard against accidents. When the delete removes inbound edges, the response is wrapped in a next_actions envelope suggesting a follow-up `rank_notes(method=pagerank, minIncomingLinks=0)` to spot newly orphaned notes.

vault.description: The vault to work in. `list_vaults` describes each vault.

name.description: Path or fuzzy match of the note to delete.

confirm.description: Must literally be `true` to execute. Guards against accidental deletion.

dryRun.description: If true, report what would be deleted without removing any files.

tools.name: read_canvas
tools.description: Read an Obsidian canvas (JSON Canvas) and return its nodes and edges with their ids, positions and content.

vault.description: The vault to work in. `list_vaults` describes each vault.

path.description: Vault-relative path of the `.canvas` file. The extension is optional.

tools.name: edit_canvas
tools.description: Change an Obsidian canvas: `add_node` (creates the canvas if missing; placed right of the right-most node by default), `update_node`, `delete_node` (also removes its edges), `connect` or `disconnect`. Returns the changed node or edge.

vault.description: The vault to work in. `list_vaults` describes each vault.

path.description: Vault-relative path of the `.canvas` file. The extension is optional.

subpath.description: Heading or block of a `file` node, e.g. `#Heading`. `null` removes it.

label.description: Label of a `group` node or an edge. `null` removes it.

color.description: Preset `"1"`-`"6"` or hex like `"#ff0000"`. `null` removes it.

tools.name: reindex
tools.description: Re-index the vault: re-embeds notes whose mtime changed and prunes orphan stubs.

vault.description: The vault to work in. `list_vaults` describes each vault.

tools.name: index_status
tools.description: Report the current state of the vault index: embedder model + dim, count of notes / chunks indexed, chunks skipped during the last reindex (if any), advertised vs discovered max tokens, last reindex reasons, whether a reindex is currently in flight, and the last init error. Read-only — does not mutate anything.

vault.description: The vault to work in. `list_vaults` describes each vault.

tools.name: vault_overview
tools.description: One-call orientation for an unfamiliar vault: note and attachment counts, notes per top-level folder, the most used tags, and the most recently modified notes. Use `list_tags` or `list_notes` for more than the snapshot.

vault.description: The vault to work in. `list_vaults` describes each vault.

recent.description: Recently modified notes to include. Default 10.

tools.name: list_tags
tools.description: List every tag in the vault with the number of notes that carry it. Counts frontmatter `tags`/`tag` and inline `#tags`; tags are returned without the `#`.

vault.description: The vault to work in. `list_vaults` describes each vault.

prefix.description: Only tags starting with this text, e.g. `project/`.

includeParents.description: Default `true`: a note tagged `a/b` also counts toward `a`.

tools.name: list_bookmarks
tools.description: List the vault's Obsidian bookmarks (`.obsidian/bookmarks.json`) as a tree of groups, files, folders, searches, headings and blocks. `totalItems` counts every non-group bookmark.

vault.description: The vault to work in. `list_vaults` describes each vault.

types.description: Only these bookmark types. Without `group`, group contents are flattened.

tools.name: list_property_values
tools.description: List the distinct values of one frontmatter property across notes, with how many times each occurs. Each element of a list value counts separately. Also reports how many notes have the key.

vault.description: The vault to work in. `list_vaults` describes each vault.

limit.description: Max distinct values to return. Default 100.

tools.name: update_properties
tools.description: Set and remove several frontmatter properties of one note in a single write. Creates the frontmatter block if the note has none; the body and keys not named stay as they are. Pass `dryRun: true` to see the resulting frontmatter without writing.

vault.description: The vault to work in. `list_vaults` describes each vault.

name.description: Path or fuzzy match of the note.

set.description: Keys to write, with their values. A `null` value removes the key.

remove.description: Keys to remove. Absent keys are skipped.

dryRun.description: Return the new frontmatter without writing.

tools.name: read_notes
tools.description: Read up to 20 notes in one call. Returns one entry per name, in order: `{path, title, frontmatter, content, truncated}`, or `{name, error}` when that name does not resolve.

vault.description: The vault to work in. `list_vaults` describes each vault.

names.description: Paths, filenames, or fuzzy matches of the notes to read.

maxContentLength.description: Max body chars per note before truncation. Default 2000.

tools.name: read_note_part
tools.description: Read part of a note from disk: its heading `outline`, the section under a `heading`, a range of `lines`, or the `block` that carries a `^blockId`. Line numbers are 1-based and count the frontmatter.

vault.description: The vault to work in. `list_vaults` describes each vault.

name.description: Path, filename, or fuzzy match for the note.

heading.description: For `heading`: heading text, or a nested path like `Parent > Child`.

endLine.description: For `lines`: last line, inclusive. Default and maximum: the end of the note.

blockId.description: For `block`: the block id, with or without the leading `^`.

tools.name: file_info
tools.description: Describe a vault path without its body: kind (note, attachment, folder), size, times, and for a note its link, heading, task and tag counts. Link counts come from the index.

vault.description: The vault to work in. `list_vaults` describes each vault.

path.description: Vault-relative path of a note, attachment or folder.

tools.name: create_folder
tools.description: Create a folder in the vault, with any missing parent folders. Succeeds with `created: false` when the folder already exists.

vault.description: The vault to work in. `list_vaults` describes each vault.

tools.name: delete_folder
tools.description: Permanently delete a folder. Refuses a non-empty folder unless `recursive: true`; notes inside also leave the index. Requires `confirm: true`; `dryRun` lists what would go.

vault.description: The vault to work in. `list_vaults` describes each vault.

confirm.description: Must literally be `true` to execute. Guards against accidental deletion.

recursive.description: Delete the folder with everything in it. Default false: refuse a non-empty folder.

dryRun.description: If true, report what would be deleted without removing anything.

tools.name: list_attachments
tools.description: List non-markdown files (images, PDFs, ...) with their size and `references`: how many notes link to or embed each one. `unreferencedOnly` finds orphans.

vault.description: The vault to work in. `list_vaults` describes each vault.

folder.description: Vault-relative folder to list, recursively. Default: the whole vault.

extensions.description: Keep only these extensions, case-insensitive, e.g. `["png", ".pdf"]`.

unreferencedOnly.description: Return only attachments no note references.

offset.description: Results to skip, for paging. Default 0.

tools.name: create_attachment
tools.description: Create a binary file (image, PDF, ...) from base64 content, with any missing parent folders. Max 10 MB decoded. Use `create_note` for markdown.

vault.description: The vault to work in. `list_vaults` describes each vault.

path.description: Vault-relative file path with extension, e.g. `assets/diagram.png`.

overwrite.description: Replace an existing file. Default false.

tools.name: list_tasks
tools.description: List markdown tasks (`- [ ] text`) in the vault, one folder, or one note, ordered by path and line. Each task has its 1-based `line`, raw `status` character, `state` (open/done/cancelled), `text`, nesting `indent`, `parentLine` when nested under another task, and `due` from `📅 YYYY-MM-DD`. Use `line` with `set_task_status` or `ensure_block_id`.

vault.description: The vault to work in. `list_vaults` describes each vault.

name.description: Path or fuzzy match of one note. Omit to scan the vault.

status.description: Default `open`: every status but `x`, `X` and `-`. `done`: `x`/`X`. `all` adds cancelled (`-`).

limit.description: Max tasks to return. Default 200, max 1000.

offset.description: Tasks to skip, for paging. Default 0.

tools.name: set_task_status
tools.description: Set the status of one markdown task in place. Only the character between the brackets changes; the rest of the file stays byte-identical. Refuses a line that is not a task.

vault.description: The vault to work in. `list_vaults` describes each vault.

name.description: Path or fuzzy match of the note.

line.description: 1-based line of the task, as `list_tasks` returns it.

status.description: `open` (space), `done` (`x`), or one raw status character such as `/` or `-`.

expectedText.description: The task text you expect on that line. The write is refused when it differs, e.g. after the note changed.

tools.name: ensure_block_id
tools.description: Return the `^block-id` of a block in a note, adding one when it has none, plus a ready `[[Note#^id]]` link. Target the block by `line` or by `heading` (the heading line itself). Placement follows Obsidian: ` ^id` at the end of a paragraph, list item or heading; `^id` on its own line after a table, quote, callout or code block.

vault.description: The vault to work in. `list_vaults` describes each vault.

name.description: Path or fuzzy match of the note.

heading.description: Heading text; the id goes on that heading line.

id.description: Id to write when the block has none: letters, digits, dashes. Default: random 6 characters.

dryRun.description: If true, return the id and diff without writing.

tools.name: find_broken_links
tools.description: List wikilinks whose target note is missing, or whose `#heading` / `#^block` is missing from the target. Read-only. Returns source path, 1-based line, link text and reason per broken link.

vault.description: The vault to work in. `list_vaults` describes each vault.

folder.description: Only scan notes under this folder.

tools.name: find_orphaned_notes
tools.description: List notes with no incoming wikilinks from other notes (self-links do not count). Read-only. Returns path, title and outgoing link count per orphan.

vault.description: The vault to work in. `list_vaults` describes each vault.

folder.description: Only report notes under this folder.

excludeFolders.description: Folders whose notes are not reported. Their links still count.

tools.name: search_and_replace
tools.description: Find and replace text across note bodies. Dry run by default: returns per-file match counts and before/after samples; pass `dryRun: false` to write. Skips frontmatter and fenced code unless asked.

vault.description: The vault to work in. `list_vaults` describes each vault.

pattern.description: Text to find, or a JavaScript regex when `regex` is true. `^`/`$` match at line ends.

regex.description: Treat `pattern` as a regex. Default false.

folder.description: Only touch notes under this folder.

includeFrontmatter.description: Also replace inside YAML frontmatter. Default false.

includeCode.description: Also replace inside fenced code blocks. Default false.

dryRun.description: Default true. Pass false to write.

maxFiles.description: Refuse to write when more files match. Default 200.

tools.name: rename_tag
tools.description: Rename a tag across the vault: inline `#tag` (not in code, URLs or headings) and frontmatter `tags`/`tag`. Dry run by default: returns per-file counts; pass `dryRun: false` to write.

vault.description: The vault to work in. `list_vaults` describes each vault.

dryRun.description: Default true. Pass false to write.

tools.name: rename_heading
tools.description: Rename a heading in a note and rewrite every wikilink and embed that points to it across the vault. Errors if `from` is missing or `to` already exists in the note.

vault.description: The vault to work in. `list_vaults` describes each vault.

name.description: Path or fuzzy match of the note.

dryRun.description: If true, report the changes without writing. Default false.
